notions.name: Becoming.«生成»
notions.grain: from a point, along some branch (a family closed under continuation under L); two classes L (coarse) and E (fine)
notions.quote: "Generation (生成): along some branch the pattern goes on and a carrying renewal lies ahead of every point of it." (docstring, GrammarMap.lean 272-273); chapter 02 section 1, Definition: "*Generation* (生成, shēngchéng): along some branch (such a family) the pattern goes on and from every member a carrying renewal between members lies ahead"
notions.says: There is a family S holding x, each member continued under L by a member, and from every member z some members u, v with u reached from z on the L-line and a carrying renewal «传» R L E u v.

notions.name: Becoming.«全生成»
notions.grain: the whole coarse line from x (every point it reaches); the strong form
notions.quote: "Generation in the strong form (全生成): the coarse line from `x` never ends, and ahead of every point of it lies a carrying renewal." (docstring, GrammarMap.lean 78-79); chapter: "全生成, every point the line reaches has a continuation (不穷) and from each some carrying renewal can be reached"
notions.says: «不穷» R L x, and for every y reached from x there are z, w with z reached from y and «传» R L E z w.

notions.name: Becoming.«阶生成»
notions.grain: at an order k of a sequence of classes Es; some branch
notions.quote: "Generation at every order (阶生成), read on some branch." (docstring, GrammarMap.lean 350); chapter: "generation at order `k` (the class `Es (k + 1)` going on through renewals at `Es k`)"
notions.says: It is «生成» R (Es (k + 1)) (Es k) x: generation with the coarse class the next class of the sequence and the fine class the k-th.

notions.name: Becoming.«阶全生成»
notions.grain: at an order k of a sequence of classes Es; the whole line (strong form)
notions.quote: "a sequence of classes `Es` reads generation at order `k` as the order-`k + 1` pattern continuing through order-`k` renewals" (docstring, GrammarMap.lean 192-193); chapter: "全生成 at order `k`"
notions.says: It is «全生成» R (Es (k + 1)) (Es k) x.

notions.name: Becoming.«守»
notions.grain: from a point, along some branch; no carrying renewal anywhere on that branch (strict keeping)
notions.quote: "Keeping (守): along some branch the pattern goes on with no carrying renewal on it." (docstring, GrammarMap.lean 278); chapter: "*keeping* (守, shǒu): along some branch it goes on with no carrying renewal between members"
notions.says: There is a family S holding x, each member continued under L by a member, and no two members u, v of S stand in «传» R L E u v.

notions.name: Becoming.«全守»
notions.grain: the whole coarse line from x; from some point it reaches on (earlier renewals allowed); the strong form
notions.quote: "Keeping in the strong form (全守): the coarse line from `x` never ends, and from some point on no carrying renewal lies ahead." (docstring, GrammarMap.lean 83-84); chapter: "全守, 不穷 and from some point it reaches no carrying renewal can be reached, renewals before that point allowed"
notions.says: «不穷» R L x, and some y reached from x is such that no z reached from y has a carrying renewal «传» R L E z w to any w.

notions.name: Becoming.«后守»
notions.grain: along some branch; from a point of that branch reached from x on
notions.quote: "Keeping from some point on (后守): along some branch the pattern goes on, and from a point of that branch reached from `x` no carrying renewal lies on it." (docstring, MapRegions.lean 78-79); chapter: "*Keeping from some point on* (后守, hòushǒu) closes the gap" and "every point is 生成, 后守 or 退化"
notions.says: There is a family S holding x and closed under continuation under L, and a member z of S reached from x such that no members u, v of S with u reached from z stand in «传» R L E u v.

notions.name: Becoming.«退化»
notions.grain: from a point, on every branch; one class L only (no fine class)
notions.quote: "Degeneration (退化): the pattern ends on every branch." (docstring, GrammarMap.lean 282); chapter: "*degeneration* (退化, tuìhuà) is 尽"
notions.says: It is «尽» R L x by definition (def «退化» R L x := «尽» R L x).

notions.name: Becoming.«尽»
notions.grain: from a point, on every branch (inductive); one class L
notions.quote: chapter 02 section 1, Definition: "尽 (jìn, ends): everything continuing `x` ends (inductive)" and "*degeneration* (退化, tuìhuà) is 尽"; docstring (GrammarMap.lean 227-228): "Ending on every branch (尽)"
notions.says: Inductive predicate with one constructor: «尽» R L x holds where «尽» R L y holds of every y with «续» R L x y (so at once where nothing continues x).

notions.name: Becoming.«新而尽»
notions.grain: from a point, on every branch, with a carrying renewal ahead added; a conjunction, not a region
notions.quote: "Renewing and still ending (新而尽): a carrying renewal ahead, and an end on every branch." (docstring, GrammarMap.lean 285); chapter row on witnesses: "renews and still ends on every branch: renewal does not decide the region"
notions.says: «尽» R L x together with some u reached from x and v with «传» R L E u v.

notions.name: Becoming.«息»
notions.grain: along renewing into («复生至»), under the one; NOT the pattern's own line under a coarse class. The chapter's sentence is a theorem's telling («息即尽», GrammarMap.lean 367: «息» R E x ↔ «尽» («复生至» R E) «一» x), not the definition's own words
notions.quote: chapter 02 section 1, theorem table: "Read along renewing into (复生至) under the one, ... ceasing (息) is ending on every branch." The docstring itself (Grammar.lean 648-653) says only "Ceasing (息), defined positively and inductively along renewing into" and names no degeneration.
notions.says: Inductive predicate with one constructor: «息» R E x holds where «息» R E w holds of every w that x renews into («复生至» R E x w); at once where x renews into nothing.

notions.name: Becoming.«有终»
notions.grain: the whole coarse line from x; some one point it reaches ends (existential); the third of the strong forms
notions.quote: Against listing it: docstring (GrammarMap.lean 88-89) "Reaching an end (有终): some point the coarse line from `x` reaches ends. This is not degeneration (`«退化»`, ending on every branch)."; chapter: "有终 (yǒuzhōng, reaches an end), some point the line reaches ends, which is not degeneration". For listing it apart: chapter "Three *strong forms* read the whole line from `x`: 全生成 ... 全守 ... 有终"; module account (GrammarMap.lean 20-23) "The strong forms exclude each other ... they cover every point (`«全三域之周»`)".
notions.says: Some y reached from x on the L-line (x itself or later) has no continuation under L («亡» R L y). WHY reading: neither source says it states degeneration and both deny it; I list it apart because in the strong-form trichotomy it stands in the third place, where 退化 stands among the some-branch regions, so a statement naming 全生成 or 全守 with 有终 places the generating or keeping strong form against ending.

notions.name: Becoming.«新而有终»
notions.grain: the whole coarse line from x; 有终 with a carrying renewal on the line added; a conjunction
notions.quote: docstring (GrammarMap.lean 92): "Renewing and still ending (新而终): a carrying renewal on a coarse line that ends."; module table (GrammarMap.lean 18): "renewing and still ending: a carrying renewal on a line that ends"
notions.says: «有终» R L x together with some z reached from x and w with «传» R L E z w. WHY reading: it goes wherever 有终 goes, and 有终 is itself here only by reading.

carriers.name: Becoming.«传»
carriers.why: GrammarMap.lean 60. The step relation (carrying renewal: «续» R L x y ∧ «生» R E y) by whose presence ahead or absence generation and keeping are both defined. Not a side: the chapter says of the short-life witness "renewal does not decide the region", and 新而尽 has a 传 on a line that degenerates. Named in 35 statements, so the later script should not take a statement naming 传 as naming the generating side.

refused.name: Becoming.«延»
refused.why: GrammarMap.lean 223. "Going on along some branch (延)": x lies in a family each member of which is continued under L. It is the part 生成, 守 and 后守 have in common (their first two conjuncts), so it states no ONE side; the Lean has it against 尽 (`«延尽不并»`, `«延尽之定当且仅当排中»`), i.e. not-degenerating undivided between generating and keeping. 17 statements name it. See notes: the session may want it as a marker of 'goes on, generating or keeping not said'.

refused.name: Becoming.«不穷»
refused.why: Grammar.lean 241. "The line from `x` never ends (不穷): every occurrence it reaches has a successor." The first conjunct of both 全生成 and 全守, so it states neither; the calibration sets it against 有终 (`«不穷有终之定当且仅当排中»`, which the chapter says is "a dichotomy of 不穷 against 有终, not of 全生成 against 有终"). 119 statements name it.

refused.name: Becoming.«生生»
refused.why: Grammar.lean 254. Renewal without end. Not generation: the chapter's Reading says "The map's 生成 ... is not 生生 and never overlaps degeneration"; its docstring says "It does not yet tell renewal that sustains life from turnover that destroys it". By theorem it is 延 along renewing into (`«生生即延»`), and 延 is no one side.

refused.name: Becoming.«复生»
refused.why: Grammar.lean 149. Renews (conditions a beginning that goes on). GrammarMap's account: "Renewal by itself (`«复生»`) cannot tell renewal that sustains a pattern from turnover that ends it".

refused.name: Becoming.«复生至»
refused.why: Grammar.lean 643. Renewing into; the relation 生生 and 息 are said on. A relation, not a side.

refused.name: Becoming.«粗复生»
refused.why: Grammar.lean 471. Renewal at the grain of a class; a renewal notion, and GrammarMap's account says the coarse net "is not used here".

refused.name: Becoming.«亡»
refused.why: Grammar.lean 140. "Ends (亡): nothing continues it." One of the root's four marks, at a single point; the body of 有终 uses it. Neither chapter section 1 nor its docstring calls it degeneration; a point that is 亡 meets 尽's constructor vacuously, which I read from the bodies and did not look for as a theorem.

refused.name: Becoming.«住»
refused.why: Grammar.lean 143. "Abides (住): continues something and is continued." A mark at a point, not the map's keeping: it says nothing of a carrying renewal or a second class.

refused.name: Becoming.«生»
refused.why: Grammar.lean 137. "Begins (生): nothing it is a continuation of." A mark at a point and an ingredient of 传; not generation (生成).

refused.name: Becoming.«异»
refused.why: Grammar.lean 146. Alteration: continues under E while a finer class tells apart. The chapter has `«传则异»` (a carrying renewal is an alteration); not a side. `Becoming.«化»` (GrammarReadings.lean 47) is the same form by `«化之二说同形»` and is refused with it.

refused.name: Becoming.«有常»
refused.why: Grammar.lean 338. Constancy of a class under 缘. A premise of `«有常则无终»` ("A coarse class constant under 缘 has no end from a continued point"), not a statement of keeping. `Becoming.«自持»` (Grammar.lean 573) is «有常» by definition and is refused with it.

refused.name: Becoming.«通»
refused.why: GrammarReadings.lean 111. 不穷 along 缘 and along its converse; a reading of a classical unit built from 不穷, which is itself no one side.

refused.name: Becoming.«复»

Its docstring says "A part whose levels widen those without it is generative" and the module account says "A part is generative where the levels with it widen those without it, degenerative where those without it widen those with it". No Lean, build, test or gate was run; no file was written or changed.
notes:
AI-written (Claude Fable). Lines are the table's (the docstring's first line); the `def` keyword stands one to three lines below.

1. Two names, one notion. `«退化»` is `«尽»` by definition (GrammarMap.lean 284: def «退化» R L x := «尽» R L x). Statements name either (55 and 22); a statement naming 尽 and no 退化 still states the degenerating side. `«阶生成»` and `«阶全生成»` are likewise 生成 and 全生成 at the classes Es (k+1), Es k.

2. Keeping is three notions that are not one. 守 (no renewal anywhere on the branch) and 全守 (whole line, quiet from some point) each give 后守 (`«守则后守»`, `«全守则后守»`), and neither gives the other (`Map.Once.keeping`, `Map.Once.not_keeps`). The chapter's first Definition names 守 as keeping; its coverage theorem uses 后守 as the region (\"every point is 生成, 后守 or 退化\"). So the keeping side of the some-branch trichotomy is 后守, with 守 its strict case.

3. Two trichotomies at two grains, and the third place differs. Some branch / every branch: 生成, 后守 (or 守), 退化. Whole line (strong forms): 全生成, 全守, 有终. The chapter and the docstring both say 有终 \"is not degeneration\"; I listed 有终 and 新而有终 under degenerates with basis \"reading\" only so that statements such as `«全生成有终不并»` and `«全守有终不并»` are not lost to the later script. If the session holds to the docstrings, drop those two and the degenerating side has no strong-form notion: not found in GrammarMap.lean, MapRegions.lean or MapInstances.lean.

4. Going on, undivided. `«延»` and `«不穷»` state that the pattern goes on without saying whether by renewing; they are refused as sides. The Lean's plainest placements of 'not degenerating' against 'degenerating' are stated on them (`«延尽不并»`, `«尽则非不穷»`, `«不穷则延»`, and the calibrations). A script that looks only for statements naming two sides will miss these unless 延 and 不穷 are given to it as a fourth marker.

5. 息 and 生生. I listed `«息»` under degenerates on the chapter's sentence, with its grain: it is 尽 only by the theorem `«息即尽»` and only at the relation `«复生至» R E` under `«一»`, which is not the pattern's line under a coarse class. `«生生»` is the matching 延 (`«生生即延»`) and so is refused with 延. A statement naming 息 with 生成 or 守 would be at two different relations; the judge of such a statement should be told.

6. 新而尽 is a conjunction (尽 and a carrying renewal ahead). A statement naming it alone already has renewal and degeneration together; it is the Lean's own form of \"renewal does not decide the region\".

7. On the World nothing new is defined. The four non-theorem declarations of MapInstances.lean are witnesses (webs and continuations). The World theorems of section 1 state the grammar's own 全生成, 全守, 有终, 退化 at `Web.continuationStep R` with `Web.activityClass`, `Web.carrierClass` or `Web.kindClass`. The chapter says so: \"These instance the strong forms; the some-branch regions are not read on the World\".

8. Chapter sentences with no non-theorem declaration behind them, in what was read (GrammarMap, MapRegions, MapInstances, Grammar): the mixed region (生守相杂) is a theorem, `Map.«生守相杂»`, with no definition of a mixed region; \"transformation\" in the Reading paragraph (\"generation, keeping, transformation and degeneration overlap\") has no region of its own there, the nearest declarations being the marks 异 and 化; \"the boundary between going on and ending\" is carried by the calibration theorems, not by a declaration.

9. The words 'generative', 'degenerative' and 'keep' also stand in Regions.lean for P2's notions (`Web.Widens`, `Web.Keeps`, `Web.Mixed`), in the docstring and the module account. By the letter of rule N-a the docstring of `Web.Widens` says \"is generative\"; I refused it for P1 because the chapter's Reading says the map's generation \"is not that widening\". Whoever reads P2 should have it.

10. 传 is listed as a carrier, not as generation at a step. If the session wants a step-grain notion of the generating side there is none other in what was read; 传 is what generation has ahead of every point and keeping lacks, and it also stands on lines that end.
